mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE > 0.3 percentage points in a 3-month window) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in 3 months (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous occurrence of high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) and negative quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an economic recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 7.0 and GDPC1 growth < 0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 5.0%), the S&P 500 is expected to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained economic growth and strong corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 5.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly) signals robust economic activity and strong corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO growth > 0.5% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 800.0) signals a weakening housing market and impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 800.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5%), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to rising interest rates and inflation concerns.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 2.0 and CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
